Indikator 4a measures the proportion of patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation who receive anticoagulation treatment at specific intervals—namely one, two, and five years—following their diagnosis. The national standard mandates a treatment coverage rate of at least 90%. Across the reporting periods, national adherence consistently hovers just below this threshold and declines as the time since diagnosis increases, dropping from 89.6% at one and two years to 87.7% at five years [^src1] [^src3] [^src4].

**One Year Post-Diagnosis**
In the 2021–2022 reporting period, the national average was 89.6%, missing the 90% target [^src1]. At the regional level, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (91.6%) and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (91.2%) were the top performers, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (87.9%) and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (88.8%) fell short [^src1]. Among individual hospitals, [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] led with 94.0%, whereas [[naestved-sygehus|Næstved Sygehus]] (72.7%) and [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] (83.0%) trailed significantly [^src1]. In the subsequent 2022–2023 period for specific regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] maintained their compliance, but [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] (87.3%) and [[hospitalsenheden-vest|Hospitalsenheden Vest]] (86.6%) missed the standard [^src2].

**Two Years Post-Diagnosis**
At the two-year mark, the national average remained at 89.6% [^src3]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (90.5%) and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (92.7%) successfully met the standard, while other regions missed it [^src3]. [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] was the highest-scoring hospital at 98.0%, and [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] reached 93.6% [^src3]. The lowest performers were [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] (53.8%) and [[naestved-sygehus|Næstved Sygehus]] (75.0%) [^src3]. A 2024 report comparing health clusters showed [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] meeting the target at 91.9%, while [[klynge-syd|Klynge SYD]] missed it at 89.1% [^src5].

**Five Years Post-Diagnosis**
By the five-year mark, the national average dropped to 87.7%, moving further from the 90% target [^src4]. Only [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (92.4%) met the regional standard [^src4]. [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] achieved a perfect 100.0%, and [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] scored 93.0% [^src4]. Conversely, [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] (71.1%) and [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] (79.7%) were the lowest performers [^src4].

**Trends and Outliers**
Treatment adherence generally declines over time, as evidenced by the national drop from 89.6% at one year to 87.7% at five years [^src1] [^src4]. [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] is a consistent outlier on the low end, failing to meet the 90% standard across all timeframes with scores of 83.0% at one year, 84.3% at two years, and 79.7% at five years [^src1] [^src3] [^src4]. In contrast, [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] is a consistent leader, maintaining exceptional compliance and reaching 100.0% at the five-year mark [^src1] [^src3] [^src4]. [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]] exhibits extreme volatility: it met the standard at one year (92.6%), plummeted to 53.8% at two years, and then recovered to 88.2% at five years [^src1] [^src3] [^src4].
